_doc: Reaction Matrix: companion x trigger x condition -> bark. Agent 3 authors the full matrix per voice sheet; Agent 2 displays them (hub idle, return from a descent, camp conversations). 'when' is a Ledger spec; 'once' reactions fire a single time; higher 'priority' wins.

aruun.text: You hurt the grazers. I haven't forgotten.
A structure should sacrifice itself before it sacrifices the people inside it. You understood that.
It'll stand a season. I'll remember who chose the season.

cigarra.text: You let the beetles walk. That was a surprising branch.
The futures around you got louder after that.
